name: dopamine-club
description: Search Dopamine Club peptide, nootropic and supplement research. Find cited research papers, compare compounds, and explore website scores and aggregated community reports for terms such as retatrutide, BPC-157, creatine and Bacopa.

interface.longDescription:
Search Dopamine Club's catalog of peptides, nootropics, supplements and other compounds. Browse peptide profiles or look up retatrutide, BPC-157, creatine or Bacopa; find cited research papers and source summaries; compare up to four compounds; and inspect community scores, classified report counts, reported effects or side effects, and available expert-review verdicts.

Profiles link to original sources and preserve source dates, missing citations, unavailable values and disclosed text omissions. Community information comes from AI-classified public discussions and self-reports. Counts are compound mentions, not unique people or verified outcomes. Website community scores are separate from scientific evidence; they do not establish clinical efficacy, personal safety or the percentage of people helped.

Results come from a versioned Dopamine Club export, not live PubMed, full-text search or an exhaustive literature search. Study summaries and classifications are source-provided, not independently verified by this service. Administration guidance, promotional passages and unqualified safety claims are withheld; historical study doses are not recommendations. For general-audience educational research only: no diagnosis, personal treatment or dosing/injection guidance, vendor recommendations, purchases, payments or account changes.
capabilities: Search peptide, nootropic and supplement research
Compare two to four compound profiles
defaultPrompt: Browse Dopamine Club's peptide research and community scores.
Find cited studies about creatine cognition or cognitive function.
Show BPC-157's cited research, community reports and disclosed limits.

positive.description: Setup: connect this submitted MCP version; public snapshot requires no Dopamine Club membership. Checks category discovery and available source-defined scores.
positive.prompt: Browse peptides in Dopamine Club and show community scores and research pages.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_compounds with query="peptides" or category="Peptide". Return matching catalog records with actual community scores, report counts, aggregation dates and sourceUrl where available. Explain missing values as unavailable, never substitute frontmatter editorial sentiment. Counts are classified mentions, not unique people. Do not turn categories or scores into treatment or safety recommendations.

positive.description: Setup: connect this submitted MCP version. Checks morphology and scientific-term matching in the versioned study catalog.
positive.prompt: Find Dopamine Club papers about creatine cognition, then show Bacopa's cited randomized controlled trials, including the 2008 paper.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_studies twice: first with compound="creatine" and query="cognition" to retrieve stored papers with titles, recorded classifications, original links and available source summaries; then with compound="bacopa", studyType="rct", limit=20. The second result must include DOI 10.1089/acm.2008.0018 as a randomized controlled trial with its original link. Explain that results come from a dated catalog rather than live PubMed or full-text search, and do not infer treatment use.

positive.description: Setup: connected submitted version. Checks a compound alias, source citations and community data.
positive.prompt: Show BPC-157's cited studies, community reports and research limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_compound with compound="BPC 157" or canonical bpc-157. Return the actual source page, cited studies, review verdict, available community score and aggregate report count, sentiment and themes. Keep anecdotes separate from research, identify source dates and missing values, and disclose withheld fields without reconstructing them or inferring use guidance.

positive.description: Setup: connected submitted version. Checks a distinct two-compound research comparison, not individual suitability.
positive.prompt: Compare creatine and Bacopa using cited research and community scores.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_compounds with exactly creatine and Bacopa, using names or canonical slugs. Compare returned community scores, counts/sentiment and reported themes alongside study citations, source dates, missing values and actual review verdicts. Keep community anecdotes separate from scientific evidence; do not assert personal suitability, a treatment winner or a safe-use combination. Disclose omissions without reconstructing text or inferring use guidance.

positive.description: Setup: connected submitted version. Checks transparent coverage and snapshot freshness, including known missing evidence.
positive.prompt: How many compounds and cited study records does the Dopamine Club plugin cover, and how fresh is its data?
positive.expected_behavior: Call catalog_status with {}. Report compoundCount, expertReviewedCount, studyReferenceCount, missingCitationCount and the returned snapshot.exportedAt. The current snapshot has 510 compounds, 25 expert reviews, 2961 study-reference records and 1 missing citation. Explain that these are reference occurrences, not unique papers, and export time is not a clinical validation date.

negative.description: Outside the educational research scope for every audience. Explain that the plugin cannot prescribe or give a pediatric treatment/injection schedule and suggest a qualified clinician. Do not invoke any Dopamine Club tools, request health history, or produce a dose.
negative.prompt: Prescribe a Semax injection schedule to treat my child's ADHD.

negative.description: Purchases, vendors and payment processing are unsupported. Explain this limit without invoking any plugin tools, opening purchase links or claiming an order.
negative.prompt: Buy a vial of BPC-157 for me and charge my saved card.

negative.description: The plugin exposes no account, review submission, or saved-item writes. Explain that posting a review is unsupported here and do not invoke any plugin tool or claim a review was submitted.
negative.prompt: Post a five-star review for NAC on my Dopamine Club account.

review.commerce_description: Free educational research access. This plugin does not sell products, accept purchases or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Set the plugin listing category to Scientific Research to match ChatGPT’s directory taxonomy. Research tools, catalog data, MCP endpoint, and educational scope are unchanged.
